narration: The hour closes four points of hurt; you rise steadier at ten of twelve. The lantern-room door is still barred from within, yet fresh salt chalk marks its outside lintel: an open eye crossed by the same three broken strokes the district hummed. No footprint approaches it. A worker recognizes none of their signs. Whoever made it knew where you stopped, but has not shown whether the mark guides a watcher, a spell, or both.

fields.summary: A fresh salt-chalk open eye crossed by three broken musical strokes appeared outside Mira's internally barred rest room; local workers do not recognize it.

dm.truth: The engine establishes that Mira is being tracked, but the tracker and whether the mark is mundane, magical, or both remain unresolved.
dm.want: lead its watcher to Mira's next exposed stop

payload.what: During Mira's post-rescue rest, an unknown hand marked the outside of her internally barred lantern room with a salt-chalk eye and three broken musical strokes; the local workers did not recognize the sign.
